title: Grade 9 Mathematics — Surface Areas and Volumes
description: Surface area and volume of cubes, cuboids, cylinders, cones, and spheres
subject: mathematics

questions.question: The total surface area of a cuboid with length l, breadth b, and height h is:
questions.explanation: Total Surface Area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl). It has 6 faces: top+bottom (2lb), front+back (2bh), left+right (2hl).

questions.question: The volume of a cube with side a is:
questions.explanation: Volume of cube = side × side × side = a³. Total surface area of cube = 6a². Lateral surface area = 4a².

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cylinder with radius r and height h is:
questions.explanation: Curved (Lateral) Surface Area of cylinder = 2πrh. Total Surface Area = 2πr(r+h) = 2πrh + 2πr². Volume = πr²h.

questions.question: Find the volume of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 10 cm. (π = 22/7)
The slant height (l) of a cone with radius r and height h is:
questions.explanation: The slant height of a cone: l = √(r² + h²). This is derived from the Pythagorean theorem — the slant height is the hypotenuse of the right triangle formed by r (base radius) and h (height).

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cone with radius r and slant height l is:
questions.explanation: CSA of cone = πrl. Total Surface Area of cone = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r). Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h.

questions.question: The volume of a cone is _____ of the volume of a cylinder with the same radius and height.
questions.explanation: Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3) × volume of cylinder. A cone is exactly 1/3 of the cylinder with the same base and height.

questions.question: The surface area of a sphere with radius r is:
questions.explanation: Surface Area of sphere = 4πr². Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³. Surface area of hemisphere (flat face + curved) = 3πr².

questions.question: A cuboid is 10 cm × 8 cm × 5 cm. Find its total surface area.
A cone has radius 5 cm and slant height 13 cm. Its curved surface area is: (use π = 3.14)
The radius of a sphere is 6 cm. Its volume is: (use π = 3.14)
If the radius of a sphere is doubled, its volume becomes:
questions.explanation: V = (4/3)πr³. If r → 2r: V_new = (4/3)π(2r)³ = (4/3)π × 8r³ = 8 × (4/3)πr³ = 8V. Volume increases 8 times.

questions.question: A cube has surface area 150 cm². Find its side length.
questions.explanation: TSA of cube = 6a². 6a² = 150 → a² = 25 → a = 5 cm.

questions.question: The total surface area of a hemisphere (flat face + curved surface) with radius r is:
questions.explanation: Hemisphere: Curved SA = 2πr², Flat circular face = πr². TSA = 2πr² + πr² = 3πr².

questions.question: A cylindrical tank has radius 1.4 m and height 3 m. How many litres of water can it hold? (π = 22/7; 1 m³ = 1000 litres)
